/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import re, collections
rows=[]
for line in open('/workspace/blast_ext.tsv'):
    p=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')
    if len(p)<25: continue
    q=p[0]; rows.append((q,p[1],int(p[6]),int(p[7]),int(p[8]),int(p[9]),p[10],p[2],p[24]))
# For each query, print best hit per non-overlapping query segment, selected by bitscore? we only have evalue and length.
for q in sorted(set(r[0] for r in rows)):
    rs=[r for r in rows if r[0]==q]
    # choose highest length per query interval approximately; greedily sort by length desc and keep non-overlap >80% with same subject
    picked=[]
    for r in sorted(rs,key=lambda x:-x[3]):
        qs,qe=r[2],r[3]
        # avoid duplicates from same subject overlap
        if any((r[1]==p[1]) and max(qs,p[2])-min(qe,p[3]) > 0.5*min(qe-qs,p[3]-p[2]) for p in picked):
            continue
        picked.append(r)
    # sort by qstart
    picked.sort(key=lambda x:x[2])
    distinct=[]
    for r in picked:
        sym=''
        m=re.search(r'\\(([A-Z0-9]+)\\)', r[8])
        if m: sym=m.group(1)
        distinct.append(f'{sym or r[1]}:{r[1]} q{r[2]}-{r[3]} s{r[4]}-{r[5]} id{r[7]}')
    if len(picked)>0:
        print(q, ' | '.join(distinct[:8]))
PY"

import re, collections
rows=[]
for line in open('/workspace/blast_ensembl_ext.tsv'):
    p=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')
    if len(p)<25: continue
    q=p[0]; s=p[1]; qs=int(p[6]); qe=int(p[7]); ss=int(p[8]); se=int(p[9]); ev=float(p[10]); ident=float(p[2]); length=int(p[3]); title=p[24]
    m=re.search(r'gene_symbol:(["'^ ]+)'"',title)
    sym=m.group(1) if m else title.split()[0]
    rows.append(dict(q=q,s=s,sym=sym,qs=qs,qe=qe,ss=ss,se=se,ev=ev,ident=ident,length=length,title=title))
# group by query
candidates=[]
for q, rs in collections.defaultdict(list).items():
    # filter strong hits
    strong=[r for r in rs if r['length']>=80 and r['ident']>=95 and r['ev']<1e-20]
    if not strong: continue
    # greedily pick best length non-overlapping hits, allowing same gene overlaps
    picked=[]
    for r in sorted(strong, key=lambda x:-x['length']):
        # skip if overlapping picked from same symbol more than 50%
        if any((r['sym']==p['sym']) and (min(r['qe'],p['qe'])-max(r['qs'],p['qs'])) > 0.5*min(r['qe']-r['qs'],p['qe']-p['qs']) for p in picked):
            continue
        # skip if overlapping different symbol significantly? keep
        picked.append(r)
    picked.sort(key=lambda x:x['qs'])
    syms=[]
    for r in picked:
        if not syms or syms[-1][0]"'!=r['"'sym'] or r['qs'] > syms[-1][2]+5:
            syms.append((r['sym'],r['qs'],r['qe'],r['length'],r['ident'],r['s'],r['title'][:80]))
    if len({s[0] for s in syms})>1:
        candidates.append((q,len(strong),syms))
print('candidate count',len(candidates))
for q,n,syms in candidates:
    print('\\nQUERY',q,'strong',n)
    for x in syms: print('  ',x)
PY"

import re, collections
# parse intersect
rows=[]
for line in open('/workspace/chim_gff_intersect.tsv'):
    p=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')
    if len(p)<16: continue
    # A columns 0-5, B 6-14, overlap 15
    name=p[3]; chromB=p[6]; feature=p[8]; start=int(p[9]); end=int(p[10]); attrs=p[14]
    gm=re.search(r'gene_name \"(["'^"]+)"'"',attrs)
    gn=gm.group(1) if gm else ''
    gt=re.search(r'transcript_name \"(["'^"]+)"'"',attrs)
    tn=gt.group(1) if gt else ''
    rows.append((name,chromB,feature,start,end,gn,tn,attrs))
by_name=collections.defaultdict(list)
for r in rows: by_name[r[0]].append(r)
# For each read, pick features: prefer exon, then transcript, then gene. Need avoid duplicates.
def get_best(rs):
    # distinct genes and features
    for feat in ['exon','CDS','transcript','gene']:
        x=[r for r in rs if r[2]==feat and r[5]]
        if x:
            # choose most frequent gene name
            cnt=collections.Counter(r[5] for r in x)
            gn=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
            # pick first with that
            return gn,feat,x[0]
    if rs:
        return rs[0][5],rs[0][2],rs[0]
    return None
pairs=collections.Counter(); pair_examples={}
reads=set()
for name,rs in by_name.items():
    base=name.rsplit('_',1)[0]
    side=name.rsplit('_',1)[1]
    if side not in ('A','B'): continue
    reads.add(base)
    b=get_best(rs)
    if not b: continue
    pair_examples[(base,side)]=b[0]
# join by base
for base in sorted(reads):
    a=pair_examples.get((base,'A')); b=pair_examples.get((base,'B'))
    if a and b:
        pairs[(a,b)]+=1
print('total chimeric reads annotated',len(reads))
for pair,n in pairs.most_common(100):
    print(n, pair[0], '->', pair[1])
PY"
